lead: A float round trip has a well-conditioned direction and an ill-conditioned one; pick the direction rather than loosening the tolerance.
body: Composing a member with its inverse amplifies the inner answer's last digits where the outer member is steep, so one way round is host-independent and the other measures libm: `asinh(sinh($x))` and `acosh(cosh($x))` are contractions, while `atanh` amplifies by `1 / (1 - $y * $y)`, so that trip is `tanh(atanh($y))` over `(-1, 1)`.
